page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c40g1.10xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features 40 dedicated vCPUs derived from 20 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 155.0 GB of system memory, averaging 3.88 GB per vCPU, paired with a single NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU carrying 16 GB of VRAM. The instance includes a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, contains no bundled local storage, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance benchmarks show a contrast between host CPU processing and GPU acceleration capabilities. Driven by an older Xeon architecture, single-core metrics fall into the lower tiers, including a Geekbench single-core score of 934.0 and weak single-threaded compression throughput. However, the 40 vCPUs deliver average performance across multi-core tasks, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 27,268.93 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression throughput of 125.4 GB/sec. Memory operations maintain standard mid-tier throughput, recording 99.06 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 42.71 GB/sec for writes.

The integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers its strongest performance in machine learning inference workloads. Benchmark measurements show top-tier prompt processing throughput, reaching 8,345.57 tokens/sec on a small 135M model and 1,129.54 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model. Medium model text generation reaches 32.93 tokens/sec. Due to the 16 GB VRAM limit, large 70B parameter models are unsupported. The architecture balances a high vCPU count with an energy-efficient inference GPU, providing qualitative cost efficiency for scaled serving over heavy GPU model training.

This server type is primarily tailored for GPU-assisted workloads, including deep learning inference, image processing pipelines, computer vision services, and video transcoding. Because local disk storage is absent, architectures require external network-attached block storage for dataset persistence and boot volumes.
